key_insight: Metal matrix coatings with polymer fillers combine metallic strength and conductivity with polymer-enabled low friction and multifunctional surface behavior.
engineering_relevance: These coatings offer tunable wear, corrosion, and surface functionality for mechanical, aerospace, oil and gas, and medical-device applications.
method: Classify coatings by metal matrix, polymer type, and filler morphology.
Compare electrodeposition, electroless deposition, thermal spray, cold spray, and hybrid/additive approaches.
Review how filler characteristics and metal–polymer interfaces affect coating properties.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a comparative literature review, not new experiments, and provides no quantitative performance benchmarks.
watch_item: Weak metal–polymer adhesion, polymer thermal limits, scale-up difficulties, and nonstandard testing remain implementation concerns.
paper_title: Metal Matrix Composite Coatings with Polymer Fillers: Fabrication Technologies, Properties, and Applications
